title: Fleet & Roster: a bigger load panel - pick A, B or C
sub: Real app, real demo data (Hendra, Regional Admin, opening Bagus Setiawan). Numbers = products you see without scrolling, counted on the page.

sections.note: All three also get: the panel on its own lighter surface with a 2 px gold edge (clear split from the name panel), and a heavier line + space above SALESMEN (clear split from the leaders).

items.cap: TODAY - 3 products. Name, keys, tabs and tools stack up and take half the panel.

A - your focus idea - 8 products. The name panel stays sharp: you can still press another name. The top bar and the day numbers dim + blur, and the panel grows into that space. Lite Mode: darker dim, no blur.
B - tall - 4 products. Same width, covers the day strip. While open it hides Sold today, Override requests, Offers and Add personnel.
C - wide - 5 products. Nothing hidden: the day numbers and the names stay. The panel takes the width, each product on one line.

sections.h: On the phone (390 x 844) - the same for A, B and C
sections.note: On the phone a person is already their own page, so there is nothing to blur. The room comes from folding the head.

pair.cap: PROPOSED - 5 products. Back key + name on one line, the 3 numbers on one line; Surat Jalan / Details / Edit / Delete behind More; the 3 tools on one row; sold today joins the numbers line.
